basis: IMF October 2026 WEO 2026 nominal GDP estimates
gdp_precision: as published, three decimals in billions

rank_computation.method: join NGDPD response keys to official DataMapper countries keys, exclude noncountry aggregates, select 2026, descending numeric sort

sources.acquisition: bounded public HTTPS research request; not Atlas crawler
sources.note: Endpoint returned a multiyear series. Only the 2026 key was selected. Raw bytes retained in scratch; this packet stores the 2026 extracted numeric observations for reproducibility.

sources.evidence: Official dataset page labels the release October 2026.

sources.access_outcome: HTML template only in web tool; no numerical claim accepted

taiwan_convention: Separate IMF-reported economy code TWN; no political classification inferred.
vintage_caveat: DataMapper endpoint is mutable, not vintage-addressed. October 2026 attribution is bound to the concurrently read WEO metadata; reruns must not silently overwrite this observation.
